home.why1: Seeds, nutrition, crop protection, irrigation and tools – everything for the farm in one place, with one order and one point of support.
home.why2: We source sealed, branded products only from authorized suppliers, distributors and brands. Batch and expiry are printed on every pack.
home.why3: Our prices stay close to market rates and are never above the printed MRP. Any discount is shown against the real MRP.
home.why4: Product details, dosage guidance and support are available in both Hindi and English.
home.newsletterTitle: Season tips and new arrivals in your inbox
home.newsletterText: One short email when there is something useful – sowing reminders, new products and guides. Unsubscribe any time.
home.seoText: KissanDukkan is an online agri-input store for farmers, kitchen gardeners and nurseries across India. Browse vegetable and field crop seeds, water-soluble fertilizers, micronutrients, insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, bio-pesticides, plant growth regulators, drip irrigation kits, battery sprayers, gardening supplies and animal husbandry products. Every product page lists the technical content, recommended dosage, safety instructions, manufacturer and country of origin, so you can choose the right input for your crop. Prices are inclusive of all taxes and never above MRP.
